name: Article 1, § 1, point 1, point b Regulation (EU) 2023/956 Article 2, § 3a, sub§ 2 – 24
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2023/956 as regards simplifying and strengthening the carbon border adjustment mechanism
part_text: The threshold laid down in point 1 of Annex VII shall ensure that 98% of the emissions embedded in the imported goods and processed products pursuant to Article 2(1) and (2) are not covered by the derogation referred to in the first subparagraph.
